questions.q: Which hormone is secreted by the pancreas in response to low blood glucose levels to stimulate glycogenolysis?
questions.explain: Glucagon acts on the liver to stimulate the breakdown of glycogen into glucose (glycogenolysis) and its release into the blood to raise blood sugar levels.
